messages.author: 732a31c2f861aaca
messages.subject: parboot error
parts:
I am recieving an error when I use the parboot function to assess
goodness of fit for the SSE. I then decreased my nsim to 10 and it
ran ok. Any suggestions on how to run 1000 simulations.
The model I am running this on seems to have reasonable parameter
estimates and standard errors. I also tried including the statistic in
a function but got the same error. I am using this version 0.8-9 of
unmarked.
####
fitStats<-function(fit){
sse<-SSE(ovenfull)
return(sse)}
parboot(ovenfull,fitStats,nsim=1000)
####


parboot(ovenfull,nsim= 1000)
Error in integrate(grhn, db[j], db[j + 1], sigma = sigma[i], rel.tol =
rel.tol) :
the integral is probably divergent
#####
Results using 10 simulations

parboot(ovenfull,nsim= 10)
Call: parboot(object = ovenfull, nsim = 10)
Parametric Bootstrap Statistics:
t0 mean(t0 - t_B) StdDev(t0 - t_B) Pr(t_B > t0)
SSE 104 7.48 14.3 0.545
t_B quantiles:
0% 2.5% 25% 50% 75% 97.5% 100%
SSE 77 77 82 105 106 110 111

t0 = Original statistic compuated from data
t_B = Vector of bootstrap samples

messages.author: df74d6fccec2ff7e
messages.subject: Re: [unmarked] parboot error
parts:
Hi Rob,

The error messages indicates that R's integrate function failed. That seems to happen often so I will fix it in the next release. For now, try refitting your model and specify a lower tolerance for the integration. eg

ovenfull <- distsamp(whatever, ... , rel.tol=0.001) # or maybe rel.tol=0.01

I think this feature is only available in unmarked version 0.8-9.

Richard

ps. parboot(ovenfull, statistic=SSE, 1000) should work too
